meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把代码评审意见压成一行式:位置、问题、修复。每条发现按严重度加🔴bug/🟡risk/🔵nit/❓q前缀,并去掉寒暄、猜测和重复描述。
howto.when: 当你说“review this PR”“code review”等,或在审查 pull request 时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我 review 这个 PR
say.note: Claude 会按极简格式输出评审意见。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审一下这次的 diff
say.note: 每条发现只写位置、问题、修复一行。

say.text: 把刚才那堆评论改成极简风格
say.note: 会去掉“我觉得”“可能”等废话,只留干货。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude turns code review comments into one-liners: location, problem, fix. Each finding gets a severity prefix (🔴 bug/🟡 risk/🔵 nit/❓ q); filler, hedging and restating are dropped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "review this PR", "code review", or similar, and auto-triggers on pull-request reviews.

say_en.note: Claude outputs findings in the compressed format.
Each finding is one line: location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: Rewrite those comments in terse style
say_en.note: Filler and hedging are stripped; only signal remains.
